name: BigCommerce
one_liner: SaaS commerce platform whose store APIs manage product catalogs, orders, customers, and storefront experiences.
auth_notes: OAuth-based API accounts: store-level (static access_token created by merchant in control panel), app-level (per-store grant code flow after install), and account-level. Store Management MCP uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE.
access_notes: Free BigCommerce trial store available for testing. Merchants create store-level API credentials in Settings > Store-level API accounts; app-level credentials are created in the Developer Portal. Cost of a production store and any plan gate are not stated.

buildability.rationale: Documented REST and GraphQL APIs with OAuth and a free trial store, but each merchant must authorize or create credentials per store; pages do not state plan gates, endpoint count, or rate limits.

identity.quote: We’re a commerce-centric company, platform, and set of retailer-facing SaaS products used to scale ecommerce businesses:

auth.quote: BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers who wish to use BigCommerce’s REST APIs:

access.quote: Sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store to test API calls and build integrations without affecting live data.
Merchants generate single-store API credentials when they create API accounts in their store control panel, in the Settings > Store-level API accounts menu.

sandbox.quote: Sign up for a free BigCommerce trial store to test API calls and build integrations without affecting live data.

api_surface.quote: OAuth API accounts can subscribe to real-time event notifications using BigCommerce’s webhooks.

mcp.quote: Store Management MCP is in early access and available to all stores.

needs_human_reason: Production store pricing and plan gates are not stated on fetched pages; rate limits, endpoint count, and pagination are not documented there; Store Management MCP is early access.
